review_evidence: This AFP hash-partition contains 555 primary Isabelle theories; 518 contain 24,625 theorem/definition/function/datatype/locale/class-family declarations under a broad structural scan.

The partition spans independent Archive of Formal Proofs entries in rewriting, model checking, program logic, cryptography, geometry, probability, semantics, and verification; declaration-light theories are heterogeneous import roots, examples, introductions/conclusions, setup, and interface modules.

Inspection of representatives such as All_Of_CAVA_LTL_Modelchecker.thy confirms that apparent import-only files preserve useful theory/module and dependency context for retrieval; no path- or declaration-count-based exclusion is lossless across the partition.
summary: Retain AFP thys hash-partition b in full as substantive Isabelle formalization content.
